headline: A 2018 executive order created a new White House council focused on American workers.
what_it_does: This order set up a group called the President's National Council for the American Worker. Only the title was available, so the council's exact members, duties, and goals are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Some federal officials would likely serve on or work with the new council, though the title alone does not say which ones.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 19, 2018; the title does not give a separate start date.
